# Results

*Generated by `scripts/make_report.py`. Latitude-weighted RMSE on 2020,
00/12 UTC init times, verified against ERA5 at 64x32 (5.625 deg).*

Competitor rows (`graphcast_2020`, `pangu_2020`, `hres_2020`,
`gencast_mean_2020`) are the models' published forecasts regridded by
WeatherBench 2 to 64x32 and scored with the identical pipeline. They were
produced at 0.25 deg with vastly more compute; our from-scratch models
(unet/vit/afno/graph) train on 4 CPU cores at 5.625 deg. The comparable
published anchor at this resolution is Rasp & Thuerey 2021 (ResNet):
z500 RMSE 268/499 m2/s2 at 3/5 days.
